pseudopotential_provenance.C.pbe-n-kjpaw_psl.1.0.0.UPF: PSlibrary 1.0.0 (kjpaw PAW), shared benchmark inventory (same file as qe-relax-co)

protocol.method: PBE plane-wave DFT, pw.x SCF single points
protocol.scan: rigid torsion of the C4-side fragment (atoms 4-6, 14-20) about the C3-C4 axis; C2-C3-C4-C5 dihedral 0/30/60/90/120/150/180 deg; all other internal coordinates frozen to the relaxed anti reference (environment/assets/hexane_anti.xyz)

calibration.reference_source: oracle solution/solve.sh run on the pinned image, x86_64, 2026-08-23
calibration.per_angle_energy_rule: abs(E_reported - E_ref) <= 1e-5 Ry (benchmark-wide QE print-resolution floor)
calibration.crossverify_rule: verifier re-runs pw.x SCF on the geometries parsed from the agent's own logs at phi = 0, 60, 180 deg; recomputed energy must match log and results.json to 1e-6 Ry

geometry_rules.dihedral: abs(observed C2-C3-C4-C5 dihedral - nominal) <= 2 deg (7-decimal alat tau-table round-trip observed ~0.4 deg)
geometry_rules.bond_fingerprint: all 19 bonds (5 C-C + 14 C-H, detected on the sha256-pinned asset) within 0.02 Angstrom of the asset (round-trip observed ~6e-4 Angstrom)

calibration.physical_sanity: anti (180 deg) is the unique minimum; every other grid point at least 0.1 kcal/mol above it
